subject: design/contract-gate-v1
statement: The two new checks — structural completeness and compilability — self-register per-file into **docgate's existing registry** via the distributed-check-registration pattern (each is one file calling the registrar at init; no shared enumeration, dispatch, or help line is edited — AP-27). A check descriptor gains an additive **`contract-scope` membership marker**. The three reused checks (`check-citations`, `GenCoverage`, the stale-flag computation) are already present or computed. The `contract-gate` verb assembles the marked subset and runs it **feature-scoped** — against one feature's assembled contract rather than the whole tree — aggregating per-check results into the verdict (§3.7). Registration order carries no meaning (assembly sorts by verb, per the DCR invariants); the marker is a read-only descriptor field, contributed at init and never mutated. Adding a future contract-scope check stays a single-file addition (`prd:contract-gate/NFR-5`).
